fact: The DGPF director says one directorate handles both the biometric ID card and civil-status records, with birth and marriage certificates being integrated into a digital database, and an integrated identity and civil-status system as the long-term aim.

The DGPF holds both registers: birth, marriage and death records are being archived electronically in the national database it also uses for identity-card enrolment, and children born abroad must have their birth transcribed before applying for the card.
The Ministry of Digital Affairs says the National Identification Number (NNI) is attributed to every person entered in a civil register, under Law 39/AN/19 of 21 January 2019.
